title: Microtubule association of EML proteins and the EML4-ALK variant 3 oncoprotein require an N-terminal trimerization domain.
inspected_scope: Genuine author-manuscript Methods, Results, Discussion and Figure 4 pixels support purified human EML1 binding to pig-brain microtubules. The 80–815 Δ-TD truncation loses binding; 23–78 is a separate isolated construct. Human EML1 self-association is measured, whereas trimer crystal structures are EML2/EML4. Overexpressed localization is not a native distribution map.
